notes.title: Big Update for September: Part 1
notes.content:
This update brings several improvements, including enhancements to the Desert Level and overall gameplay optimizations.

In this substantial update, we are thrilled to present a plethora of improvements and refinements across the entire experience, meticulously designed to enhance player immersion, gameplay fluidity, and visual fidelity. At the heart of these enhancements lies the Desert Level—the grand and final stage of the journey—where L33na, having traversed perilous terrains, overcome formidable challenges, and deciphered countless enigmas, now stands in triumphant glory. Here, she celebrates her monumental achievement: the successful collection of all fragments of the ancient and mysterious Lok'vyr, a feat that signifies not only her mastery of the trials set before her but also the culmination of an epic saga filled with discovery, strategy, and unwavering determination. Every dune, every ruin, and every hidden alcove has been meticulously polished to ensure that this ultimate level reflects the grandeur and narrative weight of L33na’s victorious journey, offering players a deeply satisfying and richly layered conclusion to her extraordinary adventure.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 – Scene 1: Slum
notes.content:
This update includes a small but important fix addressing collider issues in Scene 1 – Slum, affecting both solid objects and trigger interactions.

Important:
Due to occasional inconsistencies with Steam’s auto-update system, it is strongly recommended to uninstall the previous version and perform a clean reinstall of the game. This will ensure all updated files are correctly applied and prevent potential bugs related to leftover data from older builds.
